name: Campingplatz Sankt Alban
beschreibung: The Sankt Alban campsite is located in the municipality of Dießen am Ammersee in the Upper Bavarian Fünfseenland. The immediate surroundings are characterized by the Ammersee shoreline as well as hilly forest areas. The campsite has pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents as well as a sanitary infrastructure. The atmosphere at the site is calm and close to nature. The site is especially suitable for guests who want to combine water sports, cycling, or hiking with relaxation in nature. The central location in Fünfseenland makes the site a suitable starting point for excursions.
